convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for VWAP_Close indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position opening/closing/money management logic, requiring manual recreation of both the custom indicator logic and the trading library functions.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp alignment
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is valid

other_exits: Close long when VWAP_Close[1]>VWAP_Close[2] (indicator turns down) and BuyPosClose is enabled
Close short when VWAP_Close[1]<VWAP_Close[2] (indicator turns up) and SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Signal generation only occurs on new bars (NB.IsNewBar guard) or when Recount is true. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. The SignalBar input (default=1) determines which bar index is used for signal detection - bar 1 means signals are based on the last completed bar. Buy/Sell open and close actions are independently toggleable via input booleans (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose). GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. LoadHistory ensures sufficient bar history is loaded before signal evaluation.
python_conversion_notes: The VWAP_Close custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it computes a Volume-Weighted Average Price with a smoothing period of n=2 using tick or real volume. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions that must be recreated. The MarginMode enum (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) controls position sizing logic. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points - need digit-adjustment awareness for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). The new-bar guard pattern (CIsNewBar class) must be replicated for proper bar-based signal generation. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to open functions and may control pending order placement timing.
